task.title: Merge task description edits automatically
task.description:
Two people editing the same task description at once always get a conflict today, even when they changed different lines. Relics gained an automatic line-by-line merge for body text. This story offers the same merge for task descriptions.

## What this delivers

- When two edits to a task description meet and they changed different lines, the combined text is saved and nothing is reported.
- When they changed the same lines, the existing description conflict is reported as it is today.
- The merge is recorded in the task's history as a merge, with the texts that went into it.

## Rules that matter

- Use the merge built for relics. Do not write a second one.
- The merge runs once, on the clone that syncs second, and its result is stored. Other clones read the stored result.
- Workbook never stores conflict markers or a half-merged value.
- A task description edit does not record the text it started from today. Decide how the starting text is found for a description (the common ancestor in the task's history is the expected answer) and whether the task format needs a new change type. Any new change type declares the lowest Workbook version able to read it, and an older Workbook must stay safe.
- Teams upgrade together, but a clone on an older version must never lose or corrupt a description because a newer clone merged it.

## Done when

- Two clones editing different lines of one description both keep their work.
- Two clones editing the same lines get today's conflict, unchanged.
- The same task history gives the same description on every clone.
- The reference's conflict section describes the new behavior.
- The backlog task "Explore a decision tree for description merge conflicts" is reviewed, and either closed as covered or updated with what is left.

## Where the design is

This story builds the part "When two edits meet" of the design relic WB-R-01M8EVZ9BQR7GNFYPYHSVT6FRC, part 01M8EVZ9BQPXH99FCAW3TTRGXC.

Read it with `workbook relic show 'WB-R-01M8EVZ9BQR7GNFYPYHSVT6FRC#01M8EVZ9BQPXH99FCAW3TTRGXC' --body`.
